title: Rep. Keith Self comments on foreign policy, Sharia law, and healthcare costs - Collin Times
text:
Rep. Keith Self, a U.S. Congressman who secured reelection in both 2022 and 2024 against Sandeep Srivastava, used his social media platform to comment on issues ranging from foreign policy to healthcare and religious law in early December 2025.
On December 2, Self expressed support for former President Donald Trump’s approach to international relations, stating: “America is the greatest nation on Earth. With that greatness comes a moral duty: to be a force for good in the world. President Trump is fulfilling that duty—not with endless wars, but with peace through unapologetic strength.”
The following day, December 3, Self referenced Senator Marco Rubio’s remarks about Sharia law and its perceived global threat: “.@SecRubio is 100% right. Sharia isn’t just a threat to America and the West, but the entire world.”
Later that same day, Self criticized Democratic policies related to healthcare costs and called for an end to COVID-era subsidies associated with Obamacare: “Democrats repeatedly told us Obamacare would make healthcare cheaper. Instead, premiums have increased 221% from 2013 to 2025. Now, they are demanding we throw more money at it? No way! Let Biden’s COVID-era Obamacare subsidies EXPIRE!”
Self has maintained his seat in Congress by defeating Sandeep Srivastava in two consecutive general elections—winning by a margin of nearly two-to-one in both 2022 and 2024.
